headline: Application role gains unrestricted access to all S3 buckets in the account instead of just analytics buckets

findings.evidence_ref: Policy Resource changes from `["arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-data", "arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-data/*"]` to `["*"]`; app role now has s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:ListBucket on all S3 buckets
findings.explanation: The application role now has unrestricted read/write access to every S3 bucket in the AWS account, not just the analytics reporting buckets. This violates principle of least privilege and creates a path for data exfiltration or lateral movement to unrelated sensitive data.

findings.evidence_ref: Variable default changed from specific bucket list to wildcard Resource in resulting policy
findings.explanation: A resource-level boundary that limited the application to specific buckets is being completely removed. This should be fixed with a pattern match (e.g., `arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-analytics-*`) or resource tags instead of `["*"]`.
